description: Parameters of a renewable energy generator/converter model, this model corresponds to REGCA1 in PSSE.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

Rrpwr.description: Low Voltage Power Logic (LVPL) ramp rate limit.

Vo_lim.description: Voltage limit for high voltage reactive current management.

Lv_pnts.description: Voltage points for low voltage active current management (Lvpnt0, Lvpnt1).

Io_lim.description: Current limit for high voltage reactive current management (specified as a negative value).

T_fltr.description: Voltage filter time constant for low voltage active current management.

K_hv.description: Overvoltage compensation gain used in the high voltage reactive current management.

Iqr_lims.description: Limit on rate of change for reactive current (Iqr_min, Iqr_max).

Lvpl_sw.description: Low voltage power logic (LVPL) switch. (`false`: LVPL not present, `true`: LVPL present).

Q_ref.description: Initial condition of reactive power from power flow.

R_source.description: Output resistor used for the Thevenin Equivalent.

X_source.description: Output reactance used for the Thevenin Equivalent.

title: RenewableEnergyConverterTypeA
